name: openqodex
description: Code review before you push, from Cursor. One command runs scanners (Semgrep, Gitleaks, OSV-Scanner and more) on the lines you changed for security issues, secrets, vulnerable dependencies and lint errors, then starts a separate DipoleML or Codex reviewer that checks every scanner finding. Cursor is not the reviewer: without DipoleML or Codex installed, Cursor's agent reviews the change itself from the brief OpenQodex prints. No other key, no account.
